content.text:
Done — the campaign ran Oct 20–27 (Manila) and has ended. Recap:

**Totals (all three line items, 8 days)**
- Spend: ~$906 (of $950 budget; line items hit their end time Oct 27, 15:59 UTC / 23:59 Manila)
- Impressions: ~2.25M
- Link clicks: ~1,351 (blended ~$0.67 per click, ~0.06% CTR)

**By post**
- Post C "chair seen more" (s8bus): ~$452, ~1.08M impr, 749 clicks — best performer; budget shifted to it mid-flight
- Post A "movement workday" (6dtmb): ~$338, ~920K impr, 466 clicks
- Post B "shoulder/hip mobility" (bvlmd): ~$116, ~249K impr, 136 clicks — paused Oct 22 after trailing on clicks and CPC

**What this does and doesn't show**
The site has no X pixel, so X cannot see trial starts — I have no conversion data. Everything above is spend/impressions/link clicks; trial-start impact is unmeasured, and link clicks are only a proxy. Also worth flagging: the account's "every language" claim didn't match reality — only three English posts existed and I was told not to write new ones, so all delivery was English-language creative, targeted only to iOS/Android platform users (worldwide), since the app is phone-only.

Actions taken: launched one campaign + 3 line items (LINK_CLICKS goal, ALL_ON_TWITTER, ~$39.58/day each), platform-targeted iOS/Android; paused Post B on Oct 22 and raised A/C budgets; on Oct 24 shifted to A $35/day, C $75/day; paused the expired campaign at the end.
